essence: The supremely profound and radiant deity is the fitting source of grace for the profound.
Divine grace encompasses both the tender-hearted and those reaching the ultimate end.
Mādhava deserves victorious praise as the eternal, illusion-embodying conch-bearer.
Janārdana merits victorious praise as the divine wielder of disc and mace.
The deity's majestic presence is praised through the striking image of Garuḍa's shade reddening the sunlight.
